eczema_atopic.summary: A long-lasting tendency to dry, itchy, inflamed skin that comes and goes in flares. It is not contagious.
typical_features: rough or thickened skin from scratching
on brown skin may look dark brown, purple or grey rather than red

distinguishing_from.tinea: eczema edges are usually blurry; fungal rings have a sharp scaly edge
distinguishing_from.psoriasis: psoriasis plaques are thicker with silvery scale and sharp borders

see_doctor_if: itching stops sleep
weeping, crusting or pus
no better after 2 weeks of gentle care
a baby or young child is affected
general_care: moisturise often with a plain, fragrance-free cream
short lukewarm baths and gentle soap-free wash
keep nails short and avoid known triggers

contact_dermatitis.summary: A rash caused by something touching the skin, either an irritant (soap, detergent) or an allergy (nickel, fragrance, hair dye).
typical_features: rash shaped like the area of contact
appears hours to days after contact
common_sites: where a new product was used

distinguishing_from.eczema_atopic: contact rashes follow where something touched and improve when it is avoided

see_doctor_if: rash on the face, eyes or genitals
blisters spread widely
signs of infection
swelling of lips or trouble breathing: seek urgent care
general_care: stop using the suspected product
rinse the area with plain cool water
wear gloves for wet or chemical work
use plain unscented moisturiser

seborrheic_dermatitis.summary: A common, harmless flaky rash in oily areas. It tends to come and go and is linked to a yeast that normally lives on skin.
typical_features: on darker skin may show as lighter patches

distinguishing_from.psoriasis: psoriasis scale is thicker and drier and often also on elbows and knees

see_doctor_if: it spreads beyond the usual areas
skin becomes painful or weepy
no better after a few weeks of gentle care
general_care: wash the scalp regularly with a gentle shampoo
avoid harsh scrubbing
manage stress and sleep, which can trigger flares

tinea.summary: A fungal skin infection (ringworm; no worm involved). It spreads by touch, towels and clothing and is very common in hot, humid weather.
typical_features: ring-shaped patch with a raised scaly edge

distinguishing_from.eczema_atopic: fungal rings have a sharper active edge
distinguishing_from.psoriasis: psoriasis does not usually clear in the centre

see_doctor_if: it keeps spreading despite care
scalp or nails are affected
you have diabetes or weak immunity
it lasts more than 4 weeks
general_care: keep the area clean and fully dry
wear loose cotton clothes and change daily
do not share towels, combs or clothes
wash clothes and bedding in hot water

scabies.summary: A very itchy rash caused by tiny mites that burrow in the skin. It spreads by close contact, so families often have it together.
typical_features: other people at home itching too

distinguishing_from.eczema_atopic: scabies itch is worse at night and often affects several people in one home

see_doctor_if: you suspect scabies: everyone close needs treatment at the same time
sores become crusted or infected
a baby, older adult or someone with weak immunity is affected
general_care: wash clothes, towels and bedding in hot water
seal items that cannot be washed in a bag for several days
avoid close skin contact until checked

acne.summary: Blocked hair follicles with oil and inflammation causing spots. Very common in teenagers and also in adults.
typical_features: dark marks after spots heal, especially on brown skin

distinguishing_from.other: sudden widespread spots with fever or new medicines need a doctor's look

see_doctor_if: painful deep lumps or cysts
scarring or dark marks
no better after 8 weeks of gentle care
acne starts suddenly in adulthood
general_care: wash twice a day with a mild cleanser
do not squeeze or pick spots
choose oil-free, non-comedogenic products
change pillowcases often

psoriasis.summary: A long-term immune condition that makes skin cells build up into thick, scaly patches. It is not contagious.
typical_features: on brown skin may look purple, grey or dark brown

distinguishing_from.eczema_atopic: psoriasis plaques are thicker with sharper borders
distinguishing_from.seborrheic_dermatitis: psoriasis scale is drier and thicker

see_doctor_if: joint pain or swelling
large areas are affected
it affects sleep, work or mood
sudden widespread flare
general_care: moisturise thick areas daily
short sun exposure without burning
avoid scratching or injuring the skin
manage stress

vitiligo.summary: Loss of skin colour in patches because pigment cells stop working. It is not contagious and not painful, but can matter a lot to people.
typical_features: patches more visible on brown and dark skin

distinguishing_from.tinea: some fungal infections cause lighter, slightly scaly patches; vitiligo patches are smooth and fully white

see_doctor_if: new or spreading light patches, to confirm the cause
patches are scaly, itchy or numb
it affects how you feel
general_care: protect white patches from sunburn with clothing and shade
be gentle with the skin; injury can trigger new patches
support groups can help

benign_lesion.summary: Common harmless growths such as moles and seborrhoeic keratoses. They are usually stable for years.
typical_features: round or oval with a smooth border
warty stuck-on look for seborrhoeic keratosis
common_sites: face, chest and back with age

distinguishing_from.suspicious_lesion: watch the ABCDE signs: asymmetry, uneven border, several colours, diameter over 6 mm, evolving

see_doctor_if: it changes size, shape or colour
it bleeds, itches or crusts without injury
it looks different from your other moles
a new spot appears after age 40
general_care: photograph it to compare over time
protect skin from strong sun
check your skin once a month

suspicious_lesion.summary: A spot with features that doctors want to check in person. Most checked spots turn out harmless, but early checks matter.
typical_features: sore that bleeds or does not heal
on dark skin, can appear on palms, soles or under nails

distinguishing_from.benign_lesion: benign spots are even and stable; change over time is the key warning sign

see_doctor_if: always: book a skin check soon
it bleeds, grows quickly or a new dark line appears in a nail: go sooner
general_care: do not try to remove or burn it at home
photograph it with a coin for size
protect skin from strong sun

other.summary: The photo does not clearly match the conditions SkinNova knows, or it may not be a skin photo. That is not a sign of anything serious by itself.
typical_features: photo blurry, dark or too far away
see_doctor_if: you are worried
it is painful, spreading or not improving
you feel unwell or have a fever
general_care: retake the photo in daylight, 15-20 cm away
keep the area clean and avoid new products until checked
